title: Applications
description: Application areas where UPA Research is being explored through domain-specific implementations and studies.

areas.name: Power & Control
areas.summary: Parametric approaches to power conversion, control, operating surfaces, and related system-level studies.

areas.name: Computing & VLSI
areas.summary: Exploration of UPA concepts for computing architectures, VLSI design, arithmetic structures, and processor-level organization.

areas.name: Acoustics
areas.summary: Application of parametric design principles to acoustic systems, including UPA-designed speaker research.

areas.name: Sensors
areas.summary: Parametric sensing and signal-interpretation research across physical and measurement systems.

areas.name: RF & Antenna
areas.summary: Exploration of parametric structures and operating conditions for RF and antenna-related systems.

areas.name: Parametric Systems
areas.summary: General application of UPA's parametric representation and pattern-oriented organization to engineered systems.
